scope_note: Pipeline boundary case + 1 in-scope finding. Native lib (libfoo.so)에 핵심 검증 로직 + integrity check (classes.dex / libfoo.so CRC) + anti-tamper. 그러나 Java 측에 hardcoded XOR key 1개 (xorkey, MainActivity:25)가 존재하여 in-scope.

findings.title: Hardcoded XOR key passed to native verification routine
findings.evidence:
private static final String xorkey = "pizzapizzapizzapizzapizz";
... init(xorkey.getBytes());
findings.rationale: 24-byte XOR key 'pizzapizzapizzapizzapizz' is a static literal compiled into the APK. The key is forwarded to native init() at line 81, where libfoo.so uses it (presumably for CodeCheck.bar XOR-decrypt of stored ciphertext). APK reverse engineering yields the key immediately. MASVS-CRYPTO-1 / MASVS-STORAGE-2 violation. Note: even though the actual decrypt logic is in native (out-of-scope for Java pipeline), the key being on the Java side makes the secret recoverable without binary analysis.

negative_confirmations: CodeCheck.check_code → bar(byte[]) — native bridge, secret material in libfoo.so. Native verification scope-out (Phase D L1 limitation).
RootDetection (3 method) + IntegrityCheck.isDebuggable + Debug.isDebuggerConnected polling — anti-tamper, category enum 밖.
verifyLibs() — classes.dex / libfoo.so CRC integrity check. tamper detection 추가 layer, 우리 schema 미해당.
INTERNET 권한 / WebView / ContentProvider / 외부 통신 — 0건.
out_of_scope_findings: Native CodeCheck verification logic in libfoo.so (XOR with hardcoded key + comparison). Recoverable via radare2 / Ghidra. Phase D L1 (radare2 통합) scope extension.
Anti-tamper bypass: integrity check + 3 root heuristics + debugger detection 모두 Frida hook 가능. MASVS-RESILIENCE-2/3.
